outcome: Automate one invoice or document workflow, route exceptions to a named reviewer and measure throughput, accuracy and manual effort before wider rollout.
overview: Reduce repetitive document handling while preserving accountable review. The proposed engagement automates one invoice or document process, validates extracted fields, routes exceptions and produces an audit trail. Scope includes one intake source, up to three document layouts and one ERP test integration. Deliver a measured baseline and a reusable operating procedure.
kpi: Accepted documents per hour, human-review rate, field accuracy, exception resolution time and complete audit trace.
scope: Planning estimate: six to ten weeks for one workflow, three layouts and one test integration. Stages: baseline, extraction design, validation rules, exception handling, integration, held-out testing and controlled pilot. Require customer reviewers throughout. Handover includes source workflows, credentials ownership, exception runbook and recovery procedure. Production rollout follows accepted accuracy and process controls. Existing vendor service benchmark includes assessment, human-review design and one automation use case [CX-AA-PS].
